```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 6.5
#| fig-align: center
#| out-width: "100%"

library(ggplot2)
library(grid)

# ---------- Hilfsfunktionen -----------------------------------------------

draw_box <- function(x, y, width, height, label,
                     fill = "white", colour = "#00695C",
                     text_colour = "#1A1A1A", fontsize = 10,
                     line_width = 0.8) {
  grid.roundrect(
    x = unit(x, "npc"),
    y = unit(y, "npc"),
    width = unit(width, "npc"),
    height = unit(height, "npc"),
    r = unit(0.015, "snpc"),
    gp = gpar(fill = fill, col = colour, lwd = line_width)
  )

  grid.text(
    label = label,
    x = unit(x, "npc"),
    y = unit(y, "npc"),
    gp = gpar(
      col = text_colour,
      fontsize = fontsize,
      fontfamily = "sans",
      fontface = "plain"
    )
  )
}

draw_arrow <- function(x1, y1, x2, y2, dashed = FALSE,
                       colour = "#252525", line_width = 1) {
  grid.lines(
    x = unit(c(x1, x2), "npc"),
    y = unit(c(y1, y2), "npc"),
    arrow = arrow(
      type = "closed",
      length = unit(0.16, "cm")
    ),
    gp = gpar(
      col = colour,
      lwd = line_width,
      lty = ifelse(dashed, 2, 1)
    )
  )
}

draw_chevron <- function(x, y, width, height, label,
                         fill = "#00796B", text_colour = "white") {

  x_left  <- x - width / 2
  x_right <- x + width / 2
  y_low   <- y - height / 2
  y_high  <- y + height / 2
  tip     <- width * 0.08
  notch   <- width * 0.08

  grid.polygon(
    x = unit(
      c(
        x_left, x_right - tip, x_right,
        x_right - tip, x_left, x_left + notch
      ),
      "npc"
    ),
    y = unit(
      c(
        y_low, y_low, y,
        y_high, y_high, y
      ),
      "npc"
    ),
    gp = gpar(fill = fill, col = fill)
  )

  grid.text(
    label = label,
    x = unit(x, "npc"),
    y = unit(y, "npc"),
    gp = gpar(
      col = text_colour,
      fontsize = 14,
      fontfamily = "sans",
      fontface = "bold"
    )
  )
}

# ---------- Leere Zeichenfläche -------------------------------------------

ggplot() +
  xlim(0, 1) +
  ylim(0, 1) +
  theme_void() +
  annotation_custom(
    grobTree(

      # Prozessstufen der Supply Chain
      draw_chevron(0.18, 0.91, 0.22, 0.09, "Beschaffung"),
      draw_chevron(0.39, 0.91, 0.22, 0.09, "Produktion"),
      draw_chevron(0.60, 0.91, 0.22, 0.09, "Distribution"),
      draw_chevron(0.81, 0.91, 0.22, 0.09, "Absatz"),

      # Strategische Ebene
      draw_box(
        0.51, 0.75, 0.84, 0.09,
        "Strategische Netzwerkplanung",
        fill = "white",
        colour = "#00695C",
        fontsize = 12
      ),

      # Mittelfristige Ebene
      draw_box(0.20, 0.57, 0.22, 0.09, "Kapazitäts-\nplanung"),
      draw_box(0.50, 0.57, 0.35, 0.09, "Produktions-\nprogrammplanung"),
      draw_box(0.80, 0.57, 0.22, 0.09, "Absatz- und\nNachfrage-\nplanung"),

      # Kurzfristige Ebene – obere Reihe
      draw_box(0.20, 0.39, 0.22, 0.09, "Materialbedarfs-\nplanung"),
      draw_box(0.41, 0.39, 0.16, 0.09, "Losgrößen-\nplanung"),
      draw_box(0.60, 0.39, 0.16, 0.09, "Distributions-\nplanung"),

      # Kurzfristige Ebene – untere Reihe
      draw_box(0.20, 0.24, 0.22, 0.09, "Bestellmengen-\nplanung"),
      draw_box(0.41, 0.24, 0.16, 0.09, "Ablaufplanung"),
      draw_box(0.60, 0.24, 0.16, 0.09, "Transport-\nplanung"),
      draw_box(
        0.92, 0.21, 0.14, 0.09,
        "Fulfilment\nATP",
        fill = "white",
        colour = "#E67E22",
        text_colour = "#B35400",
        fontsize = 9
      ),

      # Vorgaben: strategische -> mittelfristige Ebene
      draw_arrow(0.20, 0.705, 0.20, 0.62),
      draw_arrow(0.50, 0.705, 0.50, 0.62),
      draw_arrow(0.80, 0.705, 0.80, 0.62),

      # Vorgaben: mittelfristige Ebene
      draw_arrow(0.31, 0.57, 0.32, 0.57),
      draw_arrow(0.20, 0.52, 0.20, 0.44),
      draw_arrow(0.50, 0.52, 0.46, 0.44),
      draw_arrow(0.58, 0.52, 0.72, 0.44),
      draw_arrow(0.80, 0.52, 0.72, 0.44),

      # Vorgaben: kurzfristige Ebene
      draw_arrow(0.31, 0.39, 0.35, 0.39),
      draw_arrow(0.57, 0.39, 0.61, 0.39),
      draw_arrow(0.20, 0.34, 0.20, 0.26),
      draw_arrow(0.46, 0.34, 0.46, 0.26),
      draw_arrow(0.72, 0.34, 0.72, 0.26),
      draw_arrow(0.31, 0.21, 0.35, 0.21),
      draw_arrow(0.57, 0.21, 0.61, 0.21),
      draw_arrow(0.83, 0.21, 0.85, 0.21),

      # Rückkopplungs- und Feedforward-Pfeile
      draw_arrow(0.15, 0.435, 0.15, 0.515, dashed = TRUE),
      draw_arrow(0.41, 0.435, 0.41, 0.515, dashed = TRUE),
      draw_arrow(0.67, 0.435, 0.67, 0.515, dashed = TRUE),
      draw_arrow(0.15, 0.255, 0.15, 0.345, dashed = TRUE),
      draw_arrow(0.41, 0.255, 0.41, 0.345, dashed = TRUE),
      draw_arrow(0.67, 0.255, 0.67, 0.345, dashed = TRUE),
      draw_arrow(0.89, 0.255, 0.89, 0.345, dashed = TRUE),

      # Planungshorizonte
      grid.text(
        "langfristig",
        x = unit(0.02, "npc"),
        y = unit(0.75, "npc"),
        just = "left",
        gp = gpar(fontsize = 9, col = "#555555", fontfamily = "sans")
      ),
      grid.text(
        "mittelfristig",
        x = unit(0.02, "npc"),
        y = unit(0.57, "npc"),
        just = "left",
        gp = gpar(fontsize = 9, col = "#555555", fontfamily = "sans")
      ),
      grid.text(
        "kurzfristig",
        x = unit(0.02, "npc"),
        y = unit(0.36, "npc"),
        just = "left",
        gp = gpar(fontsize = 9, col = "#555555", fontfamily = "sans")
      ),

      # Legende
      draw_arrow(0.18, 0.06, 0.26, 0.06),
      grid.text(
        "Vorgaben",
        x = unit(0.28, "npc"),
        y = unit(0.06, "npc"),
        just = "left",
        gp = gpar(fontsize = 9, fontfamily = "sans")
      ),
      draw_arrow(0.53, 0.06, 0.61, 0.06, dashed = TRUE),
      grid.text(
        "Feedback/Feedforward",
        x = unit(0.63, "npc"),
        y = unit(0.06, "npc"),
        just = "left",
        gp = gpar(fontsize = 9, fontfamily = "sans")
      )
    ),
    xmin = -Inf,
    xmax = Inf,
    ymin = -Inf,
    ymax = Inf
  )
```

```{tikz}
%| echo: false
%| fig-align: center
%| out-width: "100%"
%| engine.opts:
%|   extra.preamble: |
%|     \usepackage{tikz}
%|     \usetikzlibrary{shapes.arrows,arrows.meta,positioning,calc}

\begin{tikzpicture}[
  font=\small\sffamily,
  chevron/.style={
    single arrow,
    draw=none,
    fill=teal!75!black,
    minimum height=1.0cm,
    minimum width=2.2cm,
    single arrow head extend=0.25cm,
    inner sep=2pt,
    align=center,
    text=white,
    font=\small\bfseries\sffamily
  },
  planbox/.style={
    rectangle,
    draw=teal!60!black,
    fill=white,
    minimum width=3.0cm,
    minimum height=0.85cm,
    align=center,
    text width=2.8cm,
    line width=0.8pt
  },
  wideplanbox/.style={
    rectangle,
    draw=teal!60!black,
    fill=white,
    minimum width=6.3cm,
    minimum height=0.85cm,
    align=center,
    text width=6.1cm,
    line width=0.8pt
  },
  atpbox/.style={
    rectangle,
    draw=orange!80!black,
    fill=white,
    minimum width=3.0cm,
    minimum height=0.85cm,
    align=center,
    text width=2.8cm,
    line width=0.8pt,
    text=orange!80!black
  },
  fwdarrow/.style={-{Stealth[length=4pt]}, thick, black},
  fbkarrow/.style={-{Stealth[length=4pt]}, thick, black, dashed}
]

% Prozesskette
\node[chevron] (ch1) at (0,   0) {Beschaffung};
\node[chevron] (ch2) at (2.9, 0) {Produktion};
\node[chevron] (ch3) at (5.8, 0) {Distribution};
\node[chevron] (ch4) at (8.7, 0) {Absatz};

% Langfristige Ebene
\node[
  rectangle,
  draw=teal!60!black,
  fill=white,
  minimum width=11.8cm,
  minimum height=0.90cm,
  align=center,
  line width=0.8pt,
  font=\normalsize\sffamily
] (snp) at (4.35, -1.15) {Strategische Netzwerkplanung};

% Mittelfristige Ebene
\node[planbox]     (kap) at (1.55, -2.25) {Kapazitäts-\\planung};
\node[wideplanbox] (pp)  at (5.25, -2.25) {Produktions-\\programmplanung};
\node[planbox]     (anp) at (9.50, -2.25) {Absatz- und\\Nachfrage-\\Planung};

% Kurzfristige Ebene: obere Reihe
\node[planbox] (mbp) at (1.55, -3.35) {Materialbedarfs-\\planung};
\node[planbox] (lgp) at (4.70, -3.35) {Losgrößen-\\planung};
\node[planbox] (dip) at (7.85, -3.35) {Distributions-\\planung};

% Kurzfristige Ebene: untere Reihe
\node[planbox] (bmp) at (1.55, -4.45) {Bestellmengen-\\planung};
\node[planbox] (abp) at (4.70, -4.45) {Ablaufplanung};
\node[planbox] (trp) at (7.85, -4.45) {Transport-\\planung};
\node[atpbox]  (atp) at (10.55, -4.45) {\underline{Fulfilment ATP}};

% Vorgaben: strategisch -> mittelfristig
\draw[fwdarrow] (snp.south -| kap.north) -- (kap.north);
\draw[fwdarrow] (snp.south -| pp.north)  -- (pp.north);
\draw[fwdarrow] (snp.south -| anp.north) -- (anp.north);

% Horizontale Vorgabe auf mittelfristiger Ebene
\draw[fwdarrow] (kap.east) -- (pp.west);

% Vorgaben: mittelfristig -> kurzfristig
\draw[fwdarrow] (kap.south) -- (mbp.north);
\draw[fwdarrow] (pp.south)  -- (lgp.north);
\draw[fwdarrow] (pp.south)  -- (dip.north);
\draw[fwdarrow] (anp.south) -- ++(0,-0.55) -| (dip.north);

% Vorgaben: kurzfristig obere -> untere Reihe
\draw[fwdarrow] (mbp.south) -- (bmp.north);
\draw[fwdarrow] (lgp.south) -- (abp.north);
\draw[fwdarrow] (dip.south) -- (trp.north);

% Horizontale Vorgaben: kurzfristige Ebenen
\draw[fwdarrow] (mbp.east) -- (lgp.west);
\draw[fwdarrow] (lgp.east) -- (dip.west);
\draw[fwdarrow] (bmp.east) -- (abp.west);
\draw[fwdarrow] (abp.east) -- (trp.west);
\draw[fwdarrow] (trp.east) -- (atp.west);

% Feedback / Feedforward
\draw[fbkarrow] (mbp.north) -- (kap.south);
\draw[fbkarrow] (lgp.north) -- (pp.south);
\draw[fbkarrow] (dip.north) -- (pp.south);
\draw[fbkarrow] (bmp.north) -- (mbp.south);
\draw[fbkarrow] (abp.north) -- (lgp.south);
\draw[fbkarrow] (trp.north) -- (dip.south);
\draw[fbkarrow] (atp.north) -- ++(0,0.55) -| (trp.north);

% Beschriftung der Planungshorizonte
\node[anchor=east, font=\small\sffamily, text=black!70]
  at (-0.6, -1.15) {langfristig};
\node[anchor=east, font=\small\sffamily, text=black!70]
  at (-0.6, -2.25) {mittelfristig};
\node[anchor=east, font=\small\sffamily, text=black!70]
  at (-0.6, -3.90) {kurzfristig};

% Legende
\draw[fwdarrow] (0.0,-5.35) -- (0.9,-5.35)
  node[anchor=west, font=\footnotesize\sffamily] {Vorgaben};

\draw[fbkarrow] (3.5,-5.35) -- (4.4,-5.35)
  node[anchor=west, font=\footnotesize\sffamily] {Feedback/Feedforward};

\end{tikzpicture}
```
